11800.meaning2: in regular order; conformable to, suitable

11802.meaning2: feat of immovability (or a trained elephant)

11803.meaning2: who or which has reached immovability or imperturbability

11804.meaning2: who or which has reached immovability or imperturbability

11805.grammar: nt, abstr, from na iñja, neg
11805.commentary: (MNa) āneñjaṃ samāpajjatī'ti viññāṇañc'āyatan'āneñjaṃ samāpajjati. (MNa) āneñjan'ti ubhatobhāgavimutto bhavissāmā'ti āneñjaṃ arūpasamāpattiṃ manasi karoti. (ANa) āneñjappattā'ti aniñjanabhāvasādhakaṃ āneñjaṃ āneñjena ca arahattaṃ pattā.

examples.text: tassa evaṃpaṭipannassa tabbahulavihārino āyatane cittaṃ pasīdati. sampasāde sati eta'r'ahi vā āneñjaṃ samāpajjati paññāya vā adhimuccati kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā.
so evaṃ samāhite citte parisuddhe pariyodāte anaṅgaṇe vigat'ūpakkilese mudubhūte kammaniye ṭhite āneñjappatte pubbenivās'ānussatiñāṇāya cittaṃ abhininnāmeti

11806.meaning1: imperturbable; motionless; perfectly still; (comm) fourth jhāna

examples.text: tena kho pana samayena bhagavā āneñjena samādhinā nisinno hoti. atha kho tesaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ etadahosi, katamena nu kho bhagavā vihārena eta'r'ahi viharatī'ti?

11807.meaning2: feat of immovability (or a trained elephant)

11808.meaning1: connected with the imperturbable states; concerned with unshakeable meditation attainments

examples.text: āneñjapaṭisaṃyuttāya ca pana kathāya kacchamānāya na sussūsati, na sotaṃ odahati, na aññā cittaṃ upaṭṭhāpeti, na ca taṃ purisaṃ bhajati, na ca tena vittiṃ āpajjati.

11809.meaning2: who or which has reached immovability or imperturbability

11810.meaning1: reached the imperturbable state; unflappable; unshakeable

examples.text: amissīkatam'ev'assa cittaṃ hoti ṭhitaṃ āneñjappattaṃ vayañ'c'ass'ānupassati.
so evaṃ samāhite citte parisuddhe pariyodāte anaṅgaṇe vigat'ūpakkilese mudubhūte kammaniye ṭhite āneñjappatte pubbenivās'ānussatiñāṇāya cittaṃ abhininnāmesiṃ.

11812.meaning1: unshakeable perception; perception of the imperturbable states

examples.text: puna caparaṃ, bhikkhave, ariyasāvako iti paṭisañcikkhati… ye ca diṭṭhadhammikā rūpā, ye ca samparāyikā rūpā, yā ca diṭṭhadhammikā rūpasaññā, yā ca samparāyikā rūpasaññā, yā ca āneñjasaññā, sabbā saññā.

11813.meaning1: conducive to the imperturbable state; beneficial for imperturbability

examples.text: sampasāde sati eta'r'ahi vā āneñjaṃ samāpajjati paññāya vā adhimuccati kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā. ṭhānam'etaṃ vijjati yaṃ taṃsaṃvattanikaṃ viññāṇaṃ assa āneñj'ūpagaṃ. ayaṃ, bhikkhave, paṭhamā āneñjasappāyā paṭipadā akkhāyati.

11814.meaningLit: discourse on what is conducive to the imperturbable state

11815.meaning1: connection with the imperturbable states; concern with unshakeable meditation attainments

examples.text: āneñjapaṭisaṃyuttāya ca pana kathāya kacchamānāya na sussūsati, na sotaṃ odahati, na aññā cittaṃ upaṭṭhāpeti, na ca taṃ purisaṃ bhajati, na ca tena vittiṃ āpajjati. so evam'assa veditabbo, āneñjasaṃyojanena hi kho visaṃyutto.

11817.meaning1: intent on the imperturbable state; fixed on the imperturbable
11817.commentary: (MNa) āneñj'ādhimuttassā'ti kilesasiñcanavirahitāsu heṭṭhimāsu chasu samāpattīsu adhimuttassa tan'ninnassa taggaruno tappabbhārassa.

examples.text: seyyathā'pi, sunakkhatta, paṇḍupalāso bandhanā pavutto abhabbo haritattāya. evam'eva kho, sunakkhatta, āneñj'ādhimuttassa purisapuggalassa ye lok'āmisasaṃyojane se pavutte.

11818.commentary: (DNa) āneñjaṃ niccalaṃ santaṃ vipākabhūtaṃ arūpam'eva abhisaṅkharotī'ti āneñj'ābhisaṅkhāro. catunnaṃ arūp'āvacarakusalacetanānaṃ etaṃ adhivacanaṃ. yath'āha tattha katamo āneñj'ābhisaṅkhāro? kusalacetanā arūp'āvacarā, ayaṃ vuccati āneñj'ābhisaṅkhāro'ti.

examples.text: yato kho, bhikkhave, bhikkhuno avijjā pahīnā hoti vijjā uppannā, so avijjāvirāgā vijj'uppādā n'eva puññ'ābhisaṅkhāraṃ abhisaṅkharoti na apuññ'ābhisaṅkhāraṃ abhisaṅkharoti na āneñj'ābhisaṅkhāraṃ abhisaṅkharoti.

11819.meaning1: reborn in the imperturbable state; headed towards the imperturbable

examples.text: sampasāde sati eta'r'ahi vā āneñjaṃ samāpajjati paññāya vā adhimuccati kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā. ṭhānam'etaṃ vijjati yaṃ taṃsaṃvattanikaṃ viññāṇaṃ assa āneñj'ūpagaṃ. ayaṃ, bhikkhave, paṭhamā āneñjasappāyā paṭipadā akkhāyati.
apuññaṃ ce saṅkhāraṃ abhisaṅkharoti, apuññ'ūpagaṃ hoti viññāṇaṃ. āneñjaṃ ce saṅkhāraṃ abhisaṅkharoti āneñj'ūpagaṃ hoti viññāṇaṃ.

11821.meaning2: should be brought, should be fetched

11822.meaning1: brings; brings home; fetches; leads; conveys

examples.text: sace, mārisā, dev'āsurasaṅgāme samupabyūḷhe asurā jineyyuṃ devā parājineyyuṃ, yena naṃ sakkaṃ devānam'indaṃ kaṇṭhapañcamehi bandhanehi bandhitvā mama santike āneyyātha asurapuran'ti.
atītayobbano poso, āneti timbarutthaniṃ, tassā issā na supati, taṃ parābhavato mukhaṃ.

11823.meaning1: to fetch; to bring back (someone to)
11823.meaning2: to lead back; to bring back

examples.text: app'eva nāma aham'pi sakkuṇeyyaṃ acelaṃ pāthikaputtaṃ imaṃ parisaṃ ānetun'ti.

atha kho, bhante, so brāhmaṇo tassā māṇavikāya sāratto paṭibaddhacitto āpaṇā makkaṭacchāpakaṃ kiṇitvā ānetvā taṃ māṇavikaṃ etadavoca, ayaṃ te, bhoti, āpaṇā makkaṭacchāpako kiṇitvā ānīto, yo te kumārakassa kīḷāpanako bhavissatī'ti.

sīghaṃ dāruādīni āharathā'ti gahapatike vatvā gāmamajjhe vuttapakāraṃ gehaṃ kārāpetvā gāmasatato paṇṇākāraṃ āharāpetvā janapadaseṭṭhino santikā dhītaraṃ ānetvā maṅgalaṃ katvā seṭṭhissa sāsanaṃ pahiṇi, idañ'c'idañ'ca mayā katan'ti.

11826.meaning1: (gram) having distributed the meaning of a word to other words

examples.text: atha kho, bhikkhave, devā tāvatiṃsā vepacittiṃ asur'indaṃ kaṇṭhapañcamehi bandhanehi bandhitvā sakkassa devānam'indassa santike ānesuṃ sudhammaṃ devasabhaṃ.
tena kho pana samayena sambahulā itthiyo aññataraṃ bhikkhuṃ sampīḷetvā bāhāparam'parāya ānesuṃ.
kiṃ kayirā udapānena, āpā ce sabbadā siyuṃ, taṇhāya mūlato chetvā, kissa pariyesanaṃ care'ti.
ahesuṃ kho ye, bhikkhu, tayā pubbe samaṇabrāhmaṇā lokasmiṃ pathavīgarahakā pathavījigucchakā, āpagarahakā āpajigucchakā, tejagarahakā tejajigucchakā, vāyagarahakā vāyajigucchakā

11829.meaning1: who criticizes water; who finds fault with water

examples.text: ahesuṃ kho ye, bhikkhu, tayā pubbe samaṇabrāhmaṇā lokasmiṃ pathavīgarahakā pathavījigucchakā, āpagarahakā āpajigucchakā, tejagarahakā tejajigucchakā, vāyagarahakā vāyajigucchakā

11830.meaning2: who scorns or disparages (the element of) water

examples.text: yathā naro āpagam'otaritvā, mah'odakaṃ salilaṃ sīghasotaṃ, so vuyhamāno anusotagāmī, kiṃ so pare sakkhati tārayetuṃ.
dhanumhā ca āpaccayo hoti samās'ante. gāṇḍīvo dhanu yassa so'yaṃ gāṇḍīvadhanvā.

11833.meaning1: who is repulsed by water; who is disgusted with water
11833.meaning2: who spurns or despises (the element of) water

examples.text: ahesuṃ kho ye, bhikkhu, tayā pubbe samaṇabrāhmaṇā lokasmiṃ pathavīgarahakā pathavījigucchakā, āpagarahakā āpajigucchakā, tejagarahakā tejajigucchakā, vāyagarahakā vāyajigucchakā

11834.commentary: (THa) upeti gabbhañ'ca parañ'ca lokaṃ, saṃsāram'āpajja param'parāyā'ti yo pāpāni katvā apar'āparaṃ saṃsaraṇam'āpajjitvā upeti gabbhañ'ca parañ'ca lokaṃ gabbhaseyyāya paralok'uppattiyā ca na muccati

examples.text: upeti gabbhañ'ca parañ'ca lokaṃ, saṃsāram'āpajja param'parāya, tass'appapañño abhisaddahanto, upeti gabbhañ'ca parañ'ca lokaṃ.

11835.meaning1: comes to; experiences; gets (pleasure); suffers (pain); meets (with)

examples.text: tāvataken'eva tuṭṭhiṃ āpajjeyyātha
evaṃ puṭṭhā, bhikkhave, aññatitthiyā paribbājakā na c'eva sampāyissanti, uttariñ'ca vighātaṃ āpajjissanti. taṃ kissa hetu? yathā taṃ, bhikkhave, avisayasmiṃ.

11836.meaning1: arouses; exhibits; produces; brings into being

examples.text: so tathā sato viharanto taṃ dhammaṃ paññāya pavicinati pavicarati parivīmaṃsam'āpajjati.

so cakkhunā rūpaṃ disvā na nimittaggāhī hoti n'ānubyañjanaggāhī. yatv'ādhikaraṇam'enaṃ cakkhu'ndriyaṃ asaṃvutaṃ viharantaṃ abhijjhādomanassā pāpakā akusalā dhammā anvāssaveyyuṃ tassa saṃvarāya paṭipajjati, rakkhati cakkhu'ndriyaṃ, cakkhu'ndriye saṃvaraṃ āpajjati.
yo pana bhikkhu dhammikānaṃ kammānaṃ chandaṃ datvā pacchā khīyanadhammaṃ āpajjeyya, pācittiyaṃ.
yo pana bhikkhu nimantito sabhatto samāno santaṃ bhikkhuṃ anāpucchā purebhattaṃ vā pacchābhattaṃ vā kulesu cārittaṃ āpajjeyya aññatra samayā, pācittiyaṃ.
maraṇañ'h'etaṃ, sunakkhatta, ariyassa vinaye yo sikkhaṃ paccakkhāya hīnāy'āvattati, maraṇamattañ'h'etaṃ, sunakkhatta, dukkhaṃ yaṃ aññataraṃ saṃkiliṭṭhaṃ āpattiṃ āpajjati.
maraṇamattañ'h'etaṃ, bhikkhave, dukkhaṃ yadidaṃ aññataraṃ saṃkiliṭṭhaṃ āpattiṃ āpajjati. yathārūpāya āpattiyā vuṭṭhānaṃ paññāyati.

11839.commentary: (VIN 1.4.1.8) cīvare vikappaṃ āpajjeyyā'ti āyataṃ vā hotu vitthataṃ vā appitaṃ vā saṇhaṃ vā.

examples.text: tatra ce so bhikkhu pubbe appavārito upasaṅkamitvā cīvare vikappaṃ āpajjeyya, sādhu vata maṃ āyasmā iminā cīvaracetāpannena evarūpaṃ vā evarūpaṃ vā cīvaraṃ cetāpetvā acchādehī'ti

11840.meaning1: enters into a state or condition; becomes
11840.commentary: (MNa) diṭṭh'ānugatiṃ āpajjatī'ti dassan'ānugatiṃ paṭipajjati, yan'diṭṭhiko bhavaṃ gotamo yaṃkhantiko yaṃruciko, te'pi tan'diṭṭhikā honti taṃkhantikā taṃrucikā'ti attho.

examples.text: ye'me, bho gotama, kulaputtā bhavantaṃ gotamaṃ uddissa saddhā agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajitā, bhavaṃ tesaṃ gotamo pubbaṅ'gamo, bhavaṃ tesaṃ gotamo bahukāro, bhavaṃ tesaṃ gotamo samādapetā, bhoto ca pana gotamassa sā janatā diṭṭh'ānugatiṃ āpajjatī'ti.

11842.synonym: adhigacchati, adhigameti, anupāpuṇāti, appeti, pacceti, phassayati, phusati, phuseti, phussayati, sampāpuṇāti

examples.text: yassa kassaci, bhikkhave, bhikkhuno pañca cetokhilā appahīnā, pañca cetasovinibandhā asamucchinnā, so vat'imasmiṃ dhammavinaye vuddhiṃ virūḷhiṃ vepullaṃ āpajjissatī'ti, n'etaṃ ṭhānaṃ vijjati.

11843.grammar: pr, reflx 3rd sg of āpajjati, trans (+acc)

examples.text: sabbehi dhātūhi yapaccayo pubbarūpam'āpajjate vā. vuḍḍhate, phallate, dammate, sakkate, labbhate, dissate.
vaca'icc'etassa dhātussa akāro ottam'āpajjate ajjatanimhi vibhattimhi. avoca. avocuṃ. ajjatanimhī'ti kim'atthaṃ? avaca, avacū.

11846.meaning1: arousing; exhibiting; producing; bringing into being

examples.text: tassa tesaṃ vitakkānaṃ asatiamanasikāraṃ āpajjato ye pāpakā akusalā vitakkā chand'ūpasaṃhitā'pi dos'ūpasaṃhitā'pi moh'ūpasaṃhitā'pi te pahīyanti te abbhatthaṃ gacchanti.
tassa taṃ dhammaṃ paññāya pavicinato pavicayato parivīmaṃsaṃ āpajjato āraddhaṃ hoti vīriyaṃ asallīnaṃ.
āpattileso nāma lahukaṃ āpattiṃ āpajjanto diṭṭho hoti.
aññe'pi kho, vāseṭṭha, sattā tassa sattassa diṭṭh'ānugatiṃ āpajjamānā rasapathaviṃ aṅguliyā sāyiṃsu.
m'āyaṃ puriso idh'eva anayabyasanaṃ āpajjī'ti!

tasmiṃ kho, brāhmaṇa, yaññe n'eva gāvo haññiṃsu, na aj'eḷakā haññiṃsu, na kukkuṭasūkarā haññiṃsu, na vividhā pāṇā saṃghātaṃ āpajjiṃsu, na rukkhā chijjiṃsu yūp'atthāya, na dabbhā lūyiṃsu barihis'atthāya
paṭidesetabbaṃ tena bhikkhunā, gārayhaṃ, āvuso, dhammaṃ āpajjiṃ asappāyaṃ pāṭidesanīyaṃ, taṃ paṭidesemī'ti.

11852.meaning1: should be aroused (towards); should be exhibited; should be produced; should be brought into being

examples.text: tena, bhikkhave, bhikkhunā tesaṃ vitakkānaṃ asatiamanasikāro āpajjitabbo.
evarūpaṃ te, rāhula, kāyakammaṃ satthari vā viññūsu vā sabrahmacārīsu desetabbaṃ, vivaritabbaṃ, uttānīkātabbaṃ, desetvā vivaritvā uttānīkatvā āyatiṃ saṃvaraṃ āpajjitabbaṃ.

11853.commentary: (MNa) tathārūpāsu cārittaṃ āpajjitā hotī'ti evarūpāsu itthīsu sammādiṭṭhisutte vutta-micch'ācāra-lakkhaṇa-vasena vītikkamaṃ kattā hoti.

examples.text: kāmesumicchācārī hoti. yā tā māturakkhitā piturakkhitā mātāpiturakkhitā bhāturakkhitā bhaginirakkhitā ñātirakkhitā gottarakkhitā dhammarakkhitā sasāmikā saparidaṇḍā antamaso mālāguḷa-parikkhittā'pi, tathārūpāsu cārittaṃ āpajjitā hoti
so evam'āha, na kho ahaṃ, āvuso, sarāmi evarūpiṃ garukaṃ āpattiṃ āpajjitā pārājikaṃ vā pārājikasāmantaṃ vā'ti.

11854.meaning1: to experience; to produce; to attain

examples.text: evam'evaṃ kho, bhikkhave, ekādasahi dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhu abhabbo imasmiṃ dhammavinaye vuddhiṃ virūḷhiṃ vepullaṃ āpajjituṃ. katamehi ekādasahi?

11855.meaning1: (of an offence) having committed; having fallen into

examples.text: uddiṭṭhā kho āyasmanto cattāro pārājikā dhammā. yesaṃ bhikkhu aññataraṃ vā aññataraṃ vā āpajjitvā na labhati bhikkhūhi saddhiṃ saṃvāsaṃ yathā pure, tathā pacchā, pārājiko hoti asaṃvāso.
yesaṃ bhikkhu aññataraṃ vā aññataraṃ vā āpajjitvā yāvat'īhaṃ jānaṃ paṭicchādeti, tāvat'īhaṃ tena bhikkhunā akāmā parivatthabbaṃ.

11856.meaning1: having reached a state; having entered a condition

examples.text: te kāmesu pātabyataṃ āpajjanti. te kāmesu pātabyataṃ āpajjitvā kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā apāyaṃ duggatiṃ vinipātaṃ nirayaṃ upapajjanti. te tattha dukkhā tibbā kharā kaṭukā vedanā vedayanti.

11857.meaning1: would have attained; would have become

examples.text: viññāṇañ'ca hi, ānanda, daharass'eva sato vocchijjissatha kumārakassa vā kumārikāya vā, api nu kho nāmarūpaṃ vuddhiṃ virūḷhiṃ vepullaṃ āpajjissathā'ti? no h'etaṃ, bhante.
seyyathā'pi, āvuso, kaṃsapāti ābhatā āpaṇā vā kammārakulā vā rajena ca malena ca pariyonaddhā. tam'enaṃ sāmikā na c'eva paribhuñjeyyuṃ na ca pariyodapeyyuṃ, raj'āpathe ca naṃ nikkhipeyyuṃ.

11859.meaning1: name of a town in Bengal

examples.text: evaṃ me sutaṃ, ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā aṅgesu viharati āpaṇaṃ nāma aṅgānaṃ nigamo.

11860.meaning1: name of a town in Aṅguttarāpa
11860.commentary: (MNa) āpaṇaṃ nāmā'ti tasmiṃ kira nigame vīsati āpaṇamukhasahassāni vibhattāni ahesuṃ. iti so āpaṇānaṃ ussannattā āpaṇan'tv'eva saṅkhaṃ gato.

examples.text: evaṃ me sutaṃ, ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā aṅg'uttar'āpesu viharati āpaṇaṃ nāma aṅg'uttar'āpānaṃ nigamo.

11868.grammar: masc, mano group, abl sg of āpas
11868.notes: Mano-group nouns, while neuter in Sanskrit, are considered to be masculine by classical Pāḷi grammars such as Saddanīti. The example given is mano anicco, mano dukkho'ti. Counter-examples are amoghaṃ tapo and paramaṃ tapo.

examples.text: āpaṃ āpato sañjānāti, āpaṃ āpato saññatvā āpaṃ maññati, āpasmiṃ maññati, āpato maññati, āpaṃ me'ti maññati, āpaṃ abhinandati. taṃ kissa hetu? apariññātaṃ tassā'ti vadāmi.

11869.meaning1: wateriness; liquidity; fact of being water

examples.text: viññāṇaṃ anidassanaṃ anantaṃ sabbato pabhaṃ, taṃ pathaviyā pathavattena ananubhūtaṃ, āpassa āpattena ananubhūtaṃ, tejassa tejattena ananubhūtaṃ, vāyassa vāyattena ananubhūtaṃ

11870.meaning1: (vinaya) belonging to another class of offences

examples.text: aññabhāgiyassa adhikaraṇassā'ti āpatt'aññabhāgiyaṃ vā hoti adhikaraṇ'aññabhāgiyaṃ vā.

11871.meaning1: case involving offence; issue related to wrongdoing
11871.commentary: (VINa) pañca'pi āpattikkhandhā āpatt'ādhikaraṇaṃ, satta'pi āpattikkhandhā āpatt'ādhikaraṇan'ti evaṃ āpatti'y'eva āpatt'ādhikaraṇaṃ.

examples.text: adhikaraṇaṃ nāma cattāri adhikaraṇāni, vivād'ādhikaraṇaṃ, anuvād'ādhikaraṇaṃ, āpatt'ādhikaraṇaṃ, kicc'ādhikaraṇaṃ.

yasmiṃ, bhikkhave, āpatt'āpanno ca bhikkhu codako ca bhikkhu na sādhukaṃ attanā'va attānaṃ paccavekkhati tasm'etaṃ, bhikkhave, adhikaraṇe pāṭikaṅkhaṃ dīghattāya kharattāya vāḷattāya saṃvattissati, bhikkhū ca na phāsuṃ viharissantī'ti.
pathabyā ekarajjena, saggassa gamanena vā, sabbalok'ādhipaccena, sot'āpattiphalaṃ varaṃ.
abhabbo'va tāva kālaṃ kātuṃ yāva na sot'āpattiphalaṃ sacchikaroti.
sace mayaṃ imāhi āpattīhi aññam'aññaṃ kāressāma, siyā'pi taṃ adhikaraṇaṃ kakkhaḷattāya vāḷattāya bhedāya saṃvatteyya.
maraṇañ'h'etaṃ, sunakkhatta, ariyassa vinaye yo sikkhaṃ paccakkhāya hīnāy'āvattati, maraṇamattañ'h'etaṃ, sunakkhatta, dukkhaṃ yaṃ aññataraṃ saṃkiliṭṭhaṃ āpattiṃ āpajjati.
uddiṭṭhā kho āyasmanto terasa saṅgh'ādisesā dhammā nava paṭham'āpattikā, cattāro yāvatatiyakā.
idha, bhaddāli, ekacco bhikkhu abhiṇh'āpattiko hoti āpattibahulo.

11878.meaning1: skill in what entails an offence
11878.meaning2: skill in discerning what is an offence
11878.commentary: (DNa) āpattikusalatā'ti pañca'pi āpattikkhandhā āpattiyo, satta'pi āpattikkhandhā āpattiyo. yā tāsaṃ āpattīnaṃ āpattikusalatā paññā pajānanā'ti (dha. sa. 1336) evaṃ vutto āpattikusalabhāvo.

examples.text: āpattikusalatā ca āpattivuṭṭhānakusalatā ca.

11879.meaning1: class of offences; group of transgressions
11879.commentary: (ADha) pañca'pi āpattikkhandhā'ti mātikāniddesena pārājikaṃ saṅgh'ādisesaṃ pācittiyaṃ pāṭidesanīyaṃ dukkaṭan'ti imā pañca āpattiyo. satta'pi āpattikkhandhā'ti vinayaniddesena pārājikaṃ saṅgh'ādisesaṃ thull'accayaṃ pācittiyaṃ pāṭidesanīyaṃ dukkaṭaṃ dubbhāsitan'ti imā satta āpattiyo.

examples.text: yassa siyā āpattī'ti therassa vā navassa vā majjhimassa vā, pañcannaṃ vā āpattikkhandhānaṃ aññatarā āpatti, sattannaṃ vā āpattikkhandhānaṃ aññatarā āpatti.

11880.meaning2: guilty of an offence (not yet dealt with)

11881.meaning1: confessing an offence; admitting a transgression

examples.text: uddissa katañ'ca ajānitvā bhuttassa pacchā ñatvā āpattidesanākiccaṃ nāma n'atthi

11882.meaning1: (vinaya) class of offences; group of transgressions

examples.text: tass'eva āpattinikāyassa nāmakammaṃ adhivacanaṃ. tena'pi vuccati, saṅgh'ādiseso'ti.

11883.meaning1: with a limit on offences; limited to transgressions
11883.commentary: (VIN 2.5.9) āpattipariyantā nāma āpattiyo pariggahitāyo honti, ettakāhi āpattīhi ārocetabbo'ti.

examples.text: atthi bhikkhusammuti āpattipariyantā, na kulapariyantā. atthi bhikkhusammuti kulapariyantā, na āpattipariyantā, atthi bhikkhusammuti āpattipariyantā ca kulapariyantā ca, atthi bhikkhusammuti n'eva āpattipariyantā na kulapariyantā.

11884.meaning1: frequently committing offences; full of transgressions
11884.meaning2: who is full of offences; who is in the habit of offending
11884.commentary: (MNa) āpattibahulo'ti sāpattikakālo'v'assa bahu, suddho nirāpattikakālo appo'ti attho.

examples.text: idha, bhaddāli, ekacco bhikkhu abhiṇh'āpattiko hoti āpattibahulo. so bhikkhūhi vuccamāno aññen'aññaṃ paṭicarati, bahiddhā kathaṃ apanāmeti, kopañ'ca dosañ'ca appaccayañ'ca pātukaroti, na sammā vattati, na lomaṃ pāteti, na netthāraṃ vattati, yena saṅgho attamano hoti taṃ karomī'ti n'āha.

11885.meaning2: danger of offense; fear of offence
11885.commentary: (ANa) imāni kho, bhikkhave, cattāri āpattibhayānī'ti, bhikkhave, imāni cattāri āpattiṃ nissāya uppajjanakabhayāni nāmā'ti.

examples.text: imāni kho, bhikkhave, cattāri āpattibhayānī'ti.

11886.meaningLit: discourse on the danger of offenses

11887.meaningLit: section on the danger of offenses

11888.commentary: (VINa) āpattileso nāma lahukaṃ āpattiṃ āpajjanto diṭṭho hoti. tañ'ce pārājikena codeti, āpatti vācāya, vācāya saṅgh'ādisesassa.

examples.text: kiñci desaṃ lesamattaṃ upādāyā'ti leso nāma dasa lesā, jātileso, nāmaleso, gottaleso, liṅgaleso, āpattileso, pattaleso, cīvaraleso, upajjhāyaleso, ācariyaleso, sen'āsanaleso.

11889.commentary: (ANa) anāpattiyā āpattisaññī'ti āpucchitvā bhaṇḍakaṃ dhovantassa, pattaṃ pacantassa, kese chindantassa, gāmaṃ pavisantassā'ti-ādīsu anāpatti, tattha āpatti ayan'ti evaṃsaññī.

examples.text: dve'me, bhikkhave, bālā. katame dve? yo ca anāpattiyā āpattisaññī, yo ca āpattiyā anāpattisaññī. ime kho, bhikkhave, dve bālā'ti.

11890.grammar: ind, adv, comp, acc sg of āpattisāmanta
11890.meaning1: bordering on an offence; close to transgression

11891.grammar: ind, adv, comp, abl sg of āpattisāmanta
11891.meaning1: bordering on an offence; close to transgression

examples.text: katamehi pañcahi? atidūre vā gacchati accāsanne vā, na pattapariyāpannaṃ gaṇhati, āpattisāmantā bhaṇamānaṃ na nivāreti, bhaṇamānassa antar'antarā kathaṃ opāteti, duppañño hoti jaḷo eḷamūgo. imehi kho, bhikkhave, pañcahi dhammehi samannāgato pacchāsamaṇo na ādātabbo.

11892.commentary: (DNa) āpattivuṭṭhānakusalatā'ti yā tāhi āpattīhi vuṭṭhānakusalatā paññā pajānanā'ti (dha. sa. 1337) evaṃ vuttā saha kammavācāya āpattīhi vuṭṭhānaparicchedajānanā paññā.

examples.text: āpattikusalatā ca āpattivuṭṭhānakusalatā ca.

11893.commentary: (DNa) āpattivuṭṭhānakusalatā'ti yā tāhi āpattīhi vuṭṭhānakusalatā paññā pajānanā'ti (dha. sa. 1337) evaṃ vuttā saha kammavācāya āpattīhi vuṭṭhānaparicchedajānanā paññā.

examples.text: āpattikusalatā ca āpattivuṭṭhānakusalatā ca.

11894.commentary: (VINa) āpattivuṭṭhānatā vinayapurekkhāratā'ti āpattīhi vuṭṭhānabhāvo vinayaṃ purato katvā caraṇabhāvo. vadantu maṃ āyasmanto'ti hi evaṃ vadanto āpattīhi vuṭṭhahissati, vinayañ'ca purakkhatvā viharissatī'ti vuccati.

11895.meaning1: who has committed an offence; who has fallen into wrongdoing

examples.text: na ca tassa bhikkhuno aññāṇakena mutti atthi, yañ'ca āpattiṃ āpanno, tañ'ca yathādhammo kāretabbo, uttari c'assa moho āropetabbo

puna caparaṃ, bhikkhave, bhikkhū bhikkhuṃ āpattiyā codenti. so bhikkhu bhikkhūhi āpattiyā codiyamāno codakass'eva paccāropeti, tvaṃ kho'si itthan'nāmaṃ āpattiṃ āpanno, tvaṃ tāva paṭhamaṃ paṭikarohī'ti.

11896.meaning2: (for use) in case of misfortune or accident

11897.meaning1: for use in case of emergency
11897.meaning2: (for use) in case of misfortune or accident
11897.commentary: (VINa) āpad'atthāya nikkhittānī'ti aggidāhena vā purāṇabhāvena vā paṭirāj'ūparundhan'ādinā vā gopur'aṭṭālaka-rāj'antepura-hatthisāl'ādīnaṃ vipatti āpadāti vuccati. tadatthaṃ nikkhittānī'ti vuttaṃ hoti.

examples.text: atha kho vassakāro brāhmaṇo magadhamah'āmatto anattamano ahosi, kathañ'hi nāma devo devagahadārūni nagarapaṭisaṅkhārikāni āpad'atthāya nikkhittāni dhaniyassa kumbhakāraputtassa dassatī'ti!

11898.commentary: (VINa) āpadāsū'ti vāḷamigā vā corā vā anubandhanti, evarūpāsu āpadāsu anāpatti.

examples.text: āpadāsu kho, mahārāja, thāmo veditabbo. so ca kho dīghena addhunā na ittaraṃ, manasikarotā no amanasikarotā, paññavatā no duppaññena
anāpatti asañcicca, assatiyā, ajānantassa, gilānassa, āpadāsu, ummattakassa, ādikammikassā'ti.
